story_so_far: Day 1: Hamid (Lahore) got 82% in 12th but the university fee is Rs 2,00,000 a year; he tore the admission form and wrote PLAN B. Day 2: first job at a chai dhaba, 12 hours; burned hand, broke a cup, paid Rs 450 (Rs 1,200). Bilal arrived with a 'paise double' scheme. Day 3: Bilal's scheme - they each put Rs 1,000 into 10 'cheap' phones at the bazaar; at home all were plastic dummies. Angry at first, then they laughed together on the rooftop. Rs 200 left. Diary: 'Aaj bhi bach gaye. Kal: teen naukriyan!' Day 4 (Teen Naukriyan): 5 AM newspaper round on an old cycle - chain broke, finished 40 houses on foot chased by a dog (+Rs 150); late to the dhaba, Rs 100 cut (+Rs 350); night tuition for Ali (Class 5) - fell asleep, Ali's ammi caught him, but Ali said 'sir taught best today', she paid Rs 300 and said 'kal bhi aana'. Rs 1,000. Cliffhanger: an unknown number calls about a delivery job - battery 1%, phone dies. Day 5 (Phone Mar Gaya): phone dead; charger plugged in - loadshedding; Bilal had sold his charger (scheme #2); paid Rs 50 at a generator mobile shop, but balance zero; a kind stranger (Chacha, white topi + beard) lent his phone. Job confirmed: delivery rider, Rs 25,000/month - in KARACHI, day after tomorrow 9 AM. Bus ticket Rs 1,500 vs Rs 950 in pocket (Rs 550 short). Cliffhanger: Ammi overheard - 'Karachi? Tum Karachi ja rahe ho?' Day 6 (Station Ki Raat): Ammi said 'Koi Karachi nahi jayega!'; Hamid: Rs 25,000/month, Abbu ki dawai. Sold his old broken cycle to a kabadi for only Rs 300 (still Rs 250 short). At 1 AM Ammi gave him a potli: her savings Rs 400 + 6 parathay ('roz phone karna'); Abbu said nothing, just put a hand on his head. 18-hour bus (-Rs 1,500). Karachi bus adda 2 AM: chai Rs 30 -> Rs 120 left; a guard (blue cap, moustache) woke him off the bench ('Yahan sona mana hai!'); slept on the floor hugging his bag while a shady man eyed it; ate Ammi's cold parathay. Cliffhanger: wakes at 8:40 AM - interview at 9 AM, address 25 km away, rickshaw Rs 400, jeb Rs 120. Day 7 (Kiraye Ki Bike): rickshaw wanted Rs 400 (kam nahi hoga); rented a 70cc bike from Chacha Ghafoor (GHAFOOR BIKE CENTER, Rs 100/din, 'brake ki koi guarantee nahi') -> Rs 20. Traffic jam at 8:50, gali shortcut blocked by a bhains ('Sorry bhains ji'), downhill the brakes failed - crashed into cardboard boxes at the TEZ DELIVERY head office gate exactly at 9:00. The manager (blue shirt, red tie, clipboard) laughed: 'bike toh chala lete ho, test do' - first order in 30 min without brakes (chappal as brake). Ammi's voice note mid-ride ('pohanch gaye beta? nashta kiya?'). Lift kharab, 5 floors on foot; delivered with 01:12 left: first 5-star rating + Rs 50 tip -> Rs 70. NAUKRI PAKKI. Cliffhanger: back at Ghafoor's at night, he finds the dent - 'Yeh dent kis ne daala? Paanch sau nikaalo!' Jurmana Rs 500 vs jeb Rs 70. Day 8 (Barish): Ghafoor deal - dent fine paid as Rs 50/day qist + Rs 100 daily kiraya. Big order: 3 kg birthday cake, 25 min. Karachi monsoon: thunder, road became a river, engine died, his chappal floated away (funny), pushed the bike 2 km; Ammi's voice note 'bahar mat nikalna!'. Opened the box under an awning - cake melted (Rs 1,200, 'paise katenge?'). At FLAT 2-A, Master Saleem (retired teacher, white curly hair, gold glasses, maroon vest; 'Best Teacher 1998') said 'cake chhoro, tum bheeg gaye ho', gave chai + towel, asked 'parhte kyun nahi?' - '82% thay sir, fees nahi thi.' Said 'mithaas wohi hai', gave 5 stars + Rs 200 tip and a chit. Paid Ghafoor Rs 150 -> Rs 120; jurmana baaki Rs 450. Cliffhanger: chit says 'Kal subah 8 baje aana, ek imtihaan hai - M. Saleem', and the manager texts 'Kal 8 baje duty. Late = naukri khatam.' Dono 8 baje! Day 9 (Imtihaan Ya Naukri): Ghafoor's bike wouldn't start - tanki khaali, petrol Rs 100 -> Rs 20. At a fork (IMTIHAAN vs NAUKRI) he chose duty ('naukri gayi toh Abbu ki dawai bhi gayi'). Manager: 'aaj 10 order, ek bhi late = bahar'; Hamid's stomach growled in the briefing ('Sir… yeh mera pet tha'). Order 3/10 was FLAT 2-A - Master Saleem's home: a 5-question, 5-minute doorstep test while the order timer ran; his pen's ink ran out, Saleem lent his gold pen; 5/5 - 'tum scholarship ke laayak ho'. Finished 10/10 orders on an empty stomach (dizzy). Evening: spent his last Rs 20 on biscuits and shared half with a hungry street kid (new character Z, orange T-shirt). Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 0. Cliffhanger: Master Saleem texts - scholarship test parson, form fee Rs 1,000, aakhri din KAL. Jeb Rs 0. (Still owes Ghafoor jurmana Rs 450 + daily kiraya/qist.) Day 10 (Ammi Ki Call): Needed Rs 1,000 for the form by midnight with Rs 0. The manager laughed off an advance ('pehle mahina poora karo'); Bilal video-called with 'Scheme 2.0: paise triple' - Hamid cut the call. Day tips Rs 440. 6 PM Ammi called: Abbu's dawai finished, Rs 1,000 - now Rs 2,000 needed. Night shift at SETH RAUF HOTEL (new character Seth Rauf, R: slicked hair, big moustache, green waistcoat; Rs 500/night, 'cup toota toh paise katenge'); a cup flew off the tray and landed on Hamid's head without spilling ('Lahore ki training') - Rauf added Rs 100 inaam -> Rs 1,040. At 11:58 PM he sent Rs 1,000 to Ammi for the dawai; form deadline passed (FORM: BAND). Rs 40. Ammi: 'dawai le aaye, Abbu ne kha li, jeete raho'. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Cliffhanger 12:07 AM: Master Saleem texts 'Form maine bhar diya. Kal subah 9 baje test. Par ek shart hai…' (Still owes Ghafoor jurmana Rs 450 + daily kiraya/qist; Rauf's night shift may continue.) Day 11 (Ek Shart): Saleem's shart - score below 90% and Hamid owes him the Rs 1,000 form fee. After the all-night shift at Rauf's he dozed off at 6 AM and woke at 8:15 to Rauf shouting; Ghafoor refused the bike until the Rs 450 jurmana is paid; took a packed city bus hanging at the door (Rs 30 -> Rs 10), Ammi's voice note 'imtihaan achha dena', traffic jam at 8:40, ran the last 2 km. At the test center gate the guard wanted a printed admit card (print Rs 20, jeb Rs 10); the street kid Z ran up with Rs 10 ('biscuit ka badla') - inside at 8:59. Mid-paper the bijli went (fan stopped, dark hall); he finished 50/50 by window light. Saleem: 'kaisa gaya?' - 'poori jaan laga di'. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 0. Cliffhanger 6 PM: result board - HAMID 89% (scholarship needs 90%): ek number kam... ab Rs 1,000 ka karza? (Still owes Ghafoor jurmana Rs 450.) Day 12 (Ek Number Kam): Saleem texted 'shart yaad hai? Rs 1,000 itwaar tak'; the manager texted 'bike ke bina duty nahi, kal tak bike lao warna naukri khatam' - needed Rs 1,450 with Rs 0. Day shift at Seth Rauf Hotel (Rs 500, 'kuch toota toh paise katenge'), lunch rush, tray nearly fell. A customer (blue shirt) left without paying the Rs 300 bill - Rauf: 'teri mez thi, tere katenge'; Hamid chased him through the bazaar (jumped a bakri, lost a chappal) and caught him at the bus stop ('jaldi mein bhool gaya') - Rs 300 + Rs 50 tip. Rauf paid Rs 500 + tip -> Rs 550, 'kal bhi aana'. Offered Rs 550 to Master Saleem; he said 'paise rakho, qarza aise utaaro - mohalle ke bachon ko parhao': 10 din tuition = karza khatam (class starts tomorrow). Paid Ghafoor the Rs 450 jurmana -> bike back (kiraya Rs 100 roz), naukri bach gayi. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 100. Cliffhanger 11:45 PM: Ammi's voice note 'beta, result kya aaya?' (he typed 'Ammi, 89%...' and deleted it); then SCHOLARSHIP OFFICE: 'aapki copy recheck hui... sawaal 37 mein ghalti... naya result: ??%' - natija badal gaya, par kis taraf? (Owes nothing now except daily bike kiraya; evening tuition for Saleem's mohalla kids for 10 days.) Day 13 (Asli Certificate): the recheck came back 90% - scholarship manzoor! But Master Saleem (at the scholarship office) said the ASAL 12th certificate must be submitted by KAL 5 BAJE - and it is in Lahore with Ammi. At his first evening tuition (10 noisy mohalla kids; a paper plane hit his head) Ammi called: courier takes 3 days. Bilal's 'Scheme 3.0': his cousin is the conductor on the night Lahore-Karachi bus; Ammi gave the envelope to Bilal; Rs 100 chai-paani. Next day the bus came an hour late (4 PM); Hamid got the lifafa, paid Rs 100 (Rs 0), rode full speed and reached the office at 4:59 PM. Cliffhanger: he opened the lifafa - no certificate inside, only one of Bilal's old DUMMY PHONES (from Day 3). Where is the certificate? Deadline 5 PM. (Still: daily bike kiraya to Ghafoor; evening tuition for Saleem's mohalla kids, 10 days.) Day 14 (Dummy Phone): at 4:59 PM, with a dummy phone instead of the certificate, Bilal video-called: the lifafay got swapped - the certificate is with him, and he is in KARACHI (surprise!) at the bus adda. Master Saleem stalled the afsar with chai ('jao, bhaago!'). Hamid raced 5 km - red signal, then the bike's petrol ran out; ran the rest and found Bilal eating samosay; the certificate came back with oil stains ('bas thoda sa tel'). Rickshaw back - kiraya Bilal ne diya. 5:20 PM, the afsar's third chai: certificate jama, scholarship pakki. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 0. Cliffhanger: Bilal says he will now stay in Karachi with Hamid; the scholarship letter says classes start KAL subah 8 baje - and his delivery duty is also at 8. (Bike out of petrol at the signal; still daily kiraya to Ghafoor; evening tuition for Saleem's mohalla kids.) Day 15 (Class Ya Duty): class and delivery duty both at 8 AM. Bilal's plan: he does Hamid's duty wearing the red TEZ helmet ('koi nahi pehchanega'). First BBA class (new character P, the professor: glasses, navy blazer, grey beard) - Bilal called ('customer ka ghar nahi mil raha'), Hamid whispered the location and the professor confiscated his phone. At break: 9 missed calls + manager text 'rider ne customer ke samosay kha liye - office aao abhi'. At the office Bilal (visor up): 'samosay garam thay, check kar raha tha'. Hamid took the blame and proposed subah class, shaam double duty - manager agreed: duty 2 PM-10 PM, samosay Rs 150 tankhwah se kategi. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 0. Cliffhanger 10:15 PM: Ammi calls - 'Beta… Abbu hospital mein hain…' - and his jeb has Rs 0. (Bilal now in Karachi; daily bike kiraya to Ghafoor; evening tuition for Saleem's kids clashes with the new 2-10 PM shift.) Day 16 (Paanch Hazaar): 10:15 PM - Ammi (crying): the doctor needs Rs 5,000 by morning for Abbu's treatment/injection; Hamid has Rs 0 and promised 'main bhejunga'. Koshish #1: asked the manager for an advance by message - 'samosay walay ko? Bilkul nahi!' (REJECTED). Koshish #2: Bilal offered to sell 'his phone' - it was the Day 3 dummy phone. Koshish #3, 12 AM at Seth Rauf Hotel: Rauf shouted 'paagal ho?', Hamid offered to work free every night for Abbu's ilaaj; after a silence Rauf handed over a Rs 5,000 advance ('rona band karo'). 1 AM: sent Rs 5,000 to Ammi - injection lag gaya, Abbu theek hain. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 0. Cliffhanger 1:30 AM: Rauf's shart - a sealed brown packet (string + red seal) to deliver KAL RAAT 2 BAJE: 'kholna mat, kisi ko batana mat'. What's in the packet? (Now owes Rauf: free night work against the Rs 5,000 advance; manager's Rs 150 samosa cut; BBA class mornings + delivery duty 2-10 PM; daily bike kiraya to Ghafoor; Bilal in Karachi.) Day 17 (Raat 2 Baje): Bilal wanted to open Rauf's sealed packet ('shayad note hon!'); Hamid refused, Bilal sniffed it and sneezed (AAACHHOO, packet flew). 1:30 AM ride to a purani haveli 10 km away: tyre puncture, three dogs chased him, he pushed the bike and arrived at exactly 2:00. The haveli door creaked open by itself; an old woman (Amma ji, new character N: white chaddar, silver glasses, lavender kameez, no voice) with a lantern. Inside the packet: dawaiyan + a chit 'Ammi, maaf karna… aapka Rauf' - she is Seth Rauf's estranged mother; 'sakht Seth, andar se naram'. Amma ji gave dua + Rs 500. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Rs 500. Cliffhanger 2:45 AM: police naka - 'Kaghaz dikhao!' - but the bike is Ghafoor's and the papers are with Ghafoor. (Still owes Rauf free night work for the Rs 5,000 advance; BBA class mornings + delivery duty 2-10 PM; daily bike kiraya to Ghafoor; Bilal in Karachi.) Day 18 (Kaghaz Dikhao): 2:45 AM police naka - the havaldar said the bike goes to the thana (bike gayi = naukri gayi). Called Ghafoor - phone band, chacha snoring. Aakhri umeed: Seth Rauf at 3 AM ('pagal ho?') - Hamid: 'aapki Ammi ke ghar se aa raha hoon'; silence; 'das minute, wahin ruko'. Rauf came in pajama, a striped night cap and one chappal: 'yeh mera banda hai, chai meri taraf se!' - the havaldar laughed and let him go. Rauf softly asked 'Ammi kaisi thin?' - 'aapko bohat yaad kar rahi thin' - the sakht Seth cried. Aaj bhi bach gaye. Cliffhanger, subah: Amma ji's Rs 500 is gone from under his pillow - Bilal's chit: 'PAISE DOUBLE KARKE LAATA HOON!' (Bilal Scheme 4.0). Rs 0. (Still owes Rauf free night work for the Rs 5,000 advance; BBA class mornings + delivery duty 2-10 PM; daily bike kiraya to Ghafoor; Rauf-Amma ji reconciliation thread open.)
